findings.title: Home and local history erase saved result scope and state
findings.observed: CheckRow derives its frozen-row detail solely from check.frozen: every frozen record says Measurements only. Its ordinary measurement-kind badge likewise always says Measurement record. The component is reused for Home and local History, including fully verified 1.1.0 research_estimate/inconclusive records that ResultScreen deliberately supports, plus invalid/inconclusive legacy records. Home online availability also says Measurement-only release without consulting admitted scope. Thus the shared summary disagrees with the retained result and may disagree with the detail the user opens. This is source-established branching behavior, not a newly executed browser reproduction.
findings.impact: Customers cannot reliably identify an admitted historical research result or an invalid/inconclusive record from the saved row; capability text conceals the conditional research reader after D004 reconciliation.
findings.required_correction: Derive a concise result-state/scope label from already verified result data and current admitted capability, keep capture and synchronization states independent, preserve historical dates and fictional provenance, and keep legacy/unadmitted research closed. Do not infer approval from a local flag.
findings.verification_criterion: Rendered Home/History tests using actual verified result admission cover measurement_only, invalid, inconclusive, admitted research_estimate and admitted research abstention; rows and opened details agree, synthetic provenance remains visible, and unadmitted/legacy estimates never gain a score.

findings.title: Custom route changes announce the destination but do not move accessibility focus
findings.observed: Page navigation effect calls announceForAccessibility(title) and resets scroll restoration. Title renders a Text heading without a forwarded ref; neither Page nor custom tab routing supplies destination focus. A source search across App.tsx/src found no setAccessibilityFocus/findNodeHandle or equivalent route-heading handoff. The only explicit focus is profile validation. Announcing a title is distinct from relocating the screen reader cursor required by AND-DASH-007. No actual TalkBack/VoiceOver behavior is claimed.
findings.impact: Assistive-technology users can stay at persistent tab controls or lose their reading position instead of arriving at the destination heading. This affects orientation and task completion in the custom navigation shell.
findings.required_correction: Implement a lifecycle-safe destination-heading accessibility focus handoff for ordinary route transitions, preserving privacy cover/modal/native acquisition behavior, and restore appropriate trigger focus after dismissal/cancellation.
findings.verification_criterion: Demonstrate Home/Settings/History and deeper Back navigation with TalkBack and VoiceOver, including large text, browser auth cancellation and modal close; focus reaches the destination heading or restored trigger without reading hidden background content. Keep timed capture adaptation separate.

findings.observed: Reports explicitly retain real Android/iOS permission dialogs and Settings return, SQLCipher/OS unlock/key loss/process death, native cancellation/focus/background/timing, Bluetooth/disconnect and native share cleanup as unexecuted. Browser memory-only reload, mocked native status components and source inspection cannot establish these journeys.
